# Website Monitor

> Advanced Security, Performance, SEO, and Compliance Analysis Platform.

Website Monitor is an automated open-source web platform monitoring suite created by Fabrizio Salmi. It runs 53+ technical audits via GitHub Actions, CLI, or FastAPI REST service to inspect website security, TLS configuration, performance metrics (Core Web Vitals), SEO, accessibility, and privacy compliance.

## Platform Capabilities

### 1. Security & Cryptography (10 Checks)
- SSL/TLS Certificate validity, expiration date, and issuer chain.
- SSL Cipher Suite strength and modern protocol enforcement (TLS 1.2 / TLS 1.3).
- HTTP Security Headers: Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options.
- Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) implementation and preload verification.
- Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policy and wildcard checks.
- Mixed content detection (HTTP subresources on HTTPS origins).
- Subresource Integrity (SRI) validation on external CDN scripts.
- Rate limiting and DDoS protection detection.
- Data leakage and sensitive header exposure prevention.

### 2. Performance & Web Vitals (8 Checks)
- Google PageSpeed Insights & Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS).
- Total page load time and Time To First Byte (TTFB).
- Modern compression detection (Brotli / Gzip).
- CSS and JavaScript asset minification verification.
- CDN presence detection (Cloudflare, Fastly, CloudFront, Akamai).
- Redirect chain and 301/302 hop analysis.

### 3. SEO & Discoverability (8 Checks)
- XML Sitemap discovery and schema compliance.
- robots.txt directive parsing and crawler declarations.
- Title and meta description optimization audits.
- Canonical URL alignment and hreflang validation.
- OpenGraph and Twitter Card social preview tags.
- Schema.org structured data (JSON-LD) extraction and validation.

### 4. Privacy, Legal & Accessibility (27 Checks)
- Cookie banner and GDPR compliance indicators.
- Privacy policy and RFC 9116 security.txt declaration.
- Web accessibility (WCAG 2.1) contrast and ARIA attribute scans.

## Integration & Deployment

- **Web Dashboard**: https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/websites-monitor/
- **API Swagger UI**: https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/websites-monitor/swagger.html
- **Docker Image**: `docker pull fabriziosalmi/website-monitor:latest`
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/fabriziosalmi/websites-monitor
- **Automated Runs**: GitHub Actions workflow cron scheduling with multi-format report exports (HTML, JSON, Markdown).
